blocks.html: Robinsons Malls, through its public service program – Lingkod Pinoy Center, forged a partnership with Commission on Elections for the latter’s voter registration campaign dubbed as #MagparehistroKa2021 where Robinsons Malls will be hosting satellite registration booths in its branches nationwide.

Since Robinsons Malls are strategically located in key cities across the country, processing for voter registration will now be more conveniently accessible to the public. In preparation for the 2022 National and Local elections, COMELEC will soon be announcing the schedule of its satellite registration booths in (47) Robinsons Malls branches.
